rows.note: Use 母語 as the all-purpose term for the language learned first and regarded as one's native language.

example.english: We have spoken Cantonese at home since I was little, so Cantonese is my first language.
example.traditional: 我屋企由細到大都講廣東話，所以母語係廣東話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 so2 ji5 mou5 jyu5 hai6 gwong2 dung1 waa2

rows.jyutping: zeoi3 suk6 sik1 ge3 jyu5 jin4
rows.note: Use 最熟悉嘅語言 when you mean the language someone feels most capable and at ease using, even if it is not their native language.

example.english: I studied in Britain, but after returning to work in Hong Kong, Cantonese is still my first language—the language I feel most comfortable using.
example.traditional: 我喺英國讀完書，但返到香港做嘢，最熟悉嘅語言始終係廣東話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 jing1 gwok3 duk6 jyun4 syu1 daan6 faan2 dou3 hoeng1 gong2 zou6 je5 zeoi3 suk6 sik1 ge3 jyu5 jin4 ci2 zung1 hai6 gwong2 dung1 waa2
